appearance.followsYourComputerSLightOr: Follows your computer's light or dark setting.

identity.checkThatInboxForTheConfirmation: Check that inbox for the confirmation link.
identity.checkTheLinkInTheMail: Check {to} — the link in the mail there moves your login. Until then you still sign in as {current}.
identity.signedInAsMovingItChanges: Signed in as <email></email>. Moving it changes where you sign in, where password resets go, and where run notifications land.
identity.theConfirmationMailCouldNotBe: The confirmation mail could not be sent — ask your admin to mark the address verified.
identity.theMailToThatAddressCould: The mail to that address could not be sent — try again later.
identity.theMoveHappensWhenYouClick: The move happens when you click the link in the mail that address receives.

mfa.canAposTScanEnterThe: Can't scan? Enter the key by hand
mfa.codeFromTheAppOrA: code from the app, or a backup code
mfa.qrCodeForYourAuthenticatorApp: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.scanThisWithYourAuthenticatorApp: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
mfa.theseBackupCodesEachWorkOnce: These backup codes each work once if you lose the app. This is the only time they are shown — keep them somewhere safe.
mfa.twoFactorAuthenticationIsOffTurn: Two-factor authentication is off. Turn it on and every sign-in needs a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
mfa.twoFactorAuthenticationIsOnEvery: Two-factor authentication is on. Every sign-in asks for a code from your app.

notifications.forEveryOptionalMailAlsoCarries: For {email}. Every optional mail also carries a one-click unsubscribe for its own category.

page.aCodeFromAnAuthenticatorApp: A code from an authenticator app at every sign-in. The one thing that makes a leaked password not enough.
page.changingItDoesNotEndSessions: Changing it does not end sessions on other devices; end those below.
page.everyDeviceHoldingASessionFor: Every device holding a session for you. End one and it is signed out at once.
page.howYouAreAddressedInMail: How you are addressed in mail and shown to your team. Optional — without it you are shown by email.
page.howYouReadTimestampsEveryRun: How you read timestamps — every run time, every date, everywhere. A schedule fires on its own timezone:, not yours.
page.lightDarkOrTheSameAs: Light, dark, or the same as your computer. Yours alone, on every browser you sign in on.
page.name: Name
page.thisInstallIsRunningWithAuthentication: This install is running with authentication off (FOLDRUN_DEV_NO_AUTH=1), so there is no profile to show. Account keys and secrets are on Settings.
page.whatMailYouGetRunAlerts: What mail you get. Run alerts and approval requests can be set per {@workspace.one}; security, invites, billing failures and account notices are always sent.
page.whoSharesThisAccountWhatEach: Who shares this account, what each may do, and which {@workspace.other} each may open. Everyone shares one wallet and one shelf of shared tools.
page.whoYouAreOnThisInstall: Who you are on this install.
page.youOnThisInstallAndWho: You, on this install — and who shares the account.
page.yourLoginChangingItAsksFor: Your login. Changing it asks for your password, sends a confirmation to the new address, and tells the old one.
page.yourPictureIsShownWhereverYou: Your picture is shown wherever you are named: the top bar, the team, a run you approved.

password.theTwoNewPasswordsDoNot: the two new passwords do not match
password.theTwoNewPasswordsDoNot2: The two new passwords do not match.

sessions.lastUsedStartedSignedInWith: last used <localTime></localTime> · started <localTime2></localTime2> · signed in with
sessions.thisInstallHasNoDatabaseSo: This install has no database, so sessions are signed statements rather than stored rows — they cannot be listed or ended individually. To end every session at once, rotate FOLDRUN_SECRET_KEY.

timezone.timesAreShownInWhateverZone: Times are shown in whatever zone your device reports.
